; Commonplace — reMarkable 2, firmware 3.29.1.0
; ❝ toolbar button: capture a passage, put it on a new page at the end of the Commonplace
; notebook with "Book · p. N" typed at the top, tag the page with the book's name, log
; book/page/capture area for the Mac sync, then go back (Save) or stay to write (Save + note).

; ---------- shared state ----------
AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
TRAVERSE Item
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
    property bool qcArmed: false
    property string qcPrevPen: "primary"
    property string qcNotebookId: ""   // loaded from /home/root/commonplace/config.json
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------- the ❝ button ----------
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
IMPORT common 1.0
TRAVERSE ?#toolLayout
LOCATE AFTER Repeater#editingTools
INSERT {
    Item {
        id: qcQuoteButton
        objectName: "qcQuoteButton"
        visible: root.expanded
        Layout.preferredWidth: root.minSize.width
        Layout.preferredHeight: root.minSize.height
        Rectangle {
            anchors.fill: parent
            anchors.margins: parent.width * 0.12
            radius: width * 0.18
            color: Values.qcArmed ? "black" : "transparent"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 2
            Text {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                anchors.verticalCenterOffset: parent.height * 0.14
                text: "“"
                font.pixelSize: parent.height * 0.95
                font.bold: true
                color: Values.qcArmed ? "white" : "black"
            }
        }
        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            onClicked: {
                if (!Values.qcArmed) Values.qcPrevPen = (root.selectedPen && root.selectedPen.penToolType && root.selectedPen.penToolType !== "selection") ? root.selectedPen.penToolType : "primary";
                Values.qcArmed = !Values.qcArmed;
                console.log("QC button, armed =", Values.qcArmed);
                if (Values.qcArmed) {
                    root.selectSelection();
                    Qt.callLater(function () {
                        root.selectionToolModeSelected(ToolbarModel.SelectionToolMode.Snippet);
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------- capture -> card -> back ----------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
TRAVERSE ?#root
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
    property var qcSource: null
    property var qcIndex: []
    property bool qcIndexVisible: false
    readonly property var qcCurrentCard: root.qcFindCard(String(root.currentPageId), root.qcIndex)
    property bool qcBarVisible: false
    property bool qcBackVisible: false
    property bool qcWithNote: false
    property int qcStep: 0
    property int qcTicks: 0
    property int qcSettle: 0
    property int qcTarget: -1

    readonly property string qcDir: "file:///home/root/commonplace/"

    function qcReadJson(name, onDone) {
        const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
        x.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
            let v = null;
            try { v = JSON.parse(x.responseText); } catch (e) {}
            onDone(v);
        };
        x.open("GET", root.qcDir + name);
        x.send();
    }

    function qcWriteJson(name, value) {
        const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
        x.open("PUT", root.qcDir + name);
        x.send(JSON.stringify(value));
    }

    function qcLoad() {
        root.qcReadJson("config.json", function (c) {
            if (c && c.notebookId) Values.qcNotebookId = String(c.notebookId);
            console.log("QC notebook:", Values.qcNotebookId || "(not set up)");
        });
        root.qcReadJson("index.json", function (v) {
            root.qcIndex = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
            console.log("QC index entries:", root.qcIndex.length);
        });
    }

    function qcFindCard(pageId, index) {
        for (let i = 0; i < index.length; i++) if (index[i].cardPageId === pageId) return index[i];
        return null;
    }

    function qcOpenSource(id, page) {
        const src = Library.entryForId(id);
        if (!src) {
            root.showNotification({ message: "That book is no longer on this tablet", type: ArkTokens.NotificationBar.secondary });
            return;
        }
        documentViewTools.forceMoveTool = false;
        sceneView.endItemSelection();
        root.qcIndexVisible = false;
        root.openDocumentOnPage(src, page);
    }

    function qcGoToCard(e) {
        root.qcIndexVisible = false;
        if (!root.qcIsNotebook()) return;
        for (let i = 0; i < root.document.pageCount; i++) {
            if (String(root.document.idForPage(i)) === e.cardPageId) { root.openPage(i); return; }
        }
        root.showNotification({ message: "That notecard was deleted", type: ArkTokens.NotificationBar.secondary });
    }

    function qcFormatTime(t) {
        return Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(t), "d MMM yyyy, h:mm ap");
    }

    function qcIsNotebook() {
        return !!root.document && String(root.document.id) === Values.qcNotebookId;
    }

    function qcOnSnippet() {
        if (!Values.qcArmed || !root.document || root.qcIsNotebook()) return;
        const r = sceneView.snippetCaptureFeedbackRect;
        root.qcSource = {
            id: String(root.document.id),
            name: String(root.document.visibleName),
            fileType: root.document.fileType,
            page: root.currentPage,
            pageId: String(root.currentPageId),
            rect: { x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height },
            pageCount: root.document.pageCount,
            author: root.qcFindAuthor(),
            time: Date.now()
        };
        console.log("QC captured from", root.qcSource.name, "page", root.qcSource.page + 1);
        root.qcBarVisible = true;
    }

    function qcCancel() {
        root.qcBarVisible = false;
        Values.qcArmed = false;
    }

    function qcSave(withNote) {
        root.qcBarVisible = false;
        Values.qcArmed = false;
        root.qcWithNote = withNote;
        const nb = Values.qcNotebookId ? Library.entryForId(Values.qcNotebookId) : null;
        if (!nb) {
            root.showNotification({ message: "Commonplace notebook not set up (see the setup guide)", type: ArkTokens.NotificationBar.secondary });
            return;
        }
        root.qcStep = 1;
        root.qcTicks = 0;
        root.qcSettle = 0;
        root.openDocument(nb);
        qcTimer.start();
    }

    function qcFindAuthor() {
        const d = root.document;
        let raw = "";
        let source = "none";
        const tryVal = (v) => {
            if (!v) return "";
            if (typeof v === "string") return v;
            if (v.length !== undefined && v.length > 0) return String(v[0]) + (v.length > 1 ? " et al." : "");
            return String(v);
        };
        try { raw = tryVal(d.author); if (raw) source = "document.author"; } catch (e) {}
        if (!raw) { try { raw = tryVal(d.authors); if (raw) source = "document.authors"; } catch (e) {} }
        if (!raw) {
            try { const en = Library.entryForId(d.id); raw = tryVal(en.author) || tryVal(en.authors); if (raw) source = "library entry"; } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (!raw) {
            // download-style names: "Title -- Surname, 1926-1977, Other -- ..."
            const parts = String(d.visibleName).split(" -- ");
            if (parts.length > 1) { raw = parts[1]; source = "file name"; }
        }
        console.log("QC author from", source, ":", raw);
        return raw;
    }

    function qcShortAuthor() {
        let a = (root.qcSource.author || "").trim();
        if (!a) return "";
        let etal = "";
        if (a.endsWith(" et al.")) { etal = " et al."; a = a.slice(0, -7); }
        a = a.replace(/\[.*$/, "").replace(/;.*$/, "").trim();
        if (a.indexOf(",") > 0) a = a.split(",")[0].trim();      // "Surname, First" or "Surname, 1900-1980" -> surname
        else a = a.split(/\s+/).pop();                            // "First Surname" -> "Surname"
        return a + etal;
    }

    function qcBookName() {
        let name = root.qcSource.name;
        // tidy file-style names like "Title -- Author -- ... .pdf"
        if (name.indexOf(" -- ") > 0) name = name.split(" -- ")[0];
        name = name.replace(/\.(pdf|epub)$/i, "").replace(/\s*\(.*?\)\s*$/, "").trim();
        if (name.indexOf(": ") > 0) name = name.split(": ")[0];   // drop subtitles
        return name.length > 48 ? name.slice(0, 46) + "…" : name;
    }

    function qcDetailsText() {
        const a = root.qcShortAuthor();
        return root.qcBookName() + (a ? "  —  " + a : "") + "  ·  p. " + (root.qcSource.page + 1)
             + "  ·  " + root.qcFormatTime(root.qcSource.time);
    }

    function qcAddDetails() {
        const text = root.qcDetailsText();
        try { root.enterTextMode(true); } catch (e0) { console.log("QC enterTextMode failed:", e0); }
        try {
            Clipboard.setTextFromString(text);
            sceneController.pasteText(Clipboard.text, SceneController.KeepStyle, SceneController.MergeWithPreviousAction);
            console.log("QC label added:", text);
        } catch (e1) {
            console.log("QC label failed:", e1);
        }
        try { root.exitTextMode(false); } catch (e3) {}
    }

    function qcWriteLog(card) {
        root.qcWriteJson(card.cardPageId + ".json", card);
        const entry = {
            cardPageId: card.cardPageId,
            sourceId: card.id,
            title: root.qcBookName(),
            author: root.qcShortAuthor(),
            page: card.page,
            time: card.time
        };
        root.qcIndex = root.qcIndex.concat([entry]);
        root.qcWriteJson("index.json", root.qcIndex);
    }

    function qcGoBack() {
        root.qcBackVisible = false;
        if (!root.qcSource) return;
        root.qcOpenSource(root.qcSource.id, root.qcSource.page);
        Qt.callLater(function () { toolbar.selectPen(Values.qcPrevPen || "primary"); });
    }

    Timer {
        id: qcLoader
        interval: 800
        running: true
        repeat: false
        onTriggered: root.qcLoad()
    }

    Connections {
        target: sceneController
        function onSnippetCopied(items) { Qt.callLater(root.qcOnSnippet); }
    }

    Timer {
        id: qcTimer
        interval: 250
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: {
            root.qcTicks++;
            if (root.qcTicks > 100) {
                stop();
                console.log("QC timed out at step", root.qcStep, "page", root.currentPage, "target", root.qcTarget);
                root.qcStep = 0;
                root.showNotification({ message: "Couldn't make the notecard", type: ArkTokens.NotificationBar.secondary });
                return;
            }
            if (root.qcStep === 1) {
                // Commonplace is open and idle: add a page at the end
                if (root.qcIsNotebook() && root.documentLoaded && !root.addingPage && sceneView.status === SceneView.Active) {
                    root.qcTarget = root.document.pageCount;
                    root.qcStep = 2;
                    root.addPage(root.document, root.qcTarget);
                }
            } else if (root.qcStep === 2) {
                // wait until the new page is the one showing, then let it settle
                const onTarget = root.qcIsNotebook() && !root.addingPage && root.currentPage === root.qcTarget
                                 && sceneView.status === SceneView.Active;
                root.qcSettle = onTarget ? root.qcSettle + 1 : 0;
                if (root.qcSettle >= 3) { root.qcStep = 3; }
            } else if (root.qcStep === 3) {
                if (root.currentPage !== root.qcTarget) { root.qcStep = 2; root.qcSettle = 0; return; }
                const clipH = root.qcSource.rect ? root.qcSource.rect.h : 500;
                root.performPaste(Qt.point(0, Math.max(600, 260 + clipH / 2)));
                documentViewTools.forceMoveTool = false;
                sceneView.endItemSelection();
                root.qcAddDetails();
                LibraryController.setPageTags(root.document.id, [root.currentPage], [root.qcBookName()], []);
                root.qcWriteLog(Object.assign({}, root.qcSource, {
                    notebookId: Values.qcNotebookId,
                    cardPage: root.currentPage,
                    cardPageId: String(root.currentPageId),
                    savedAt: Date.now()
                }));
                console.log("QC card made on page", root.currentPage + 1);
                root.qcSettle = 0;
                root.qcStep = 4;
            } else if (root.qcStep === 4) {
                // give the page a moment to save before leaving
                root.qcSettle++;
                if (root.qcSettle < 4) return;
                stop();
                root.qcStep = 0;
                if (root.qcWithNote) {
                    root.qcBackVisible = true;
                    toolbar.selectPen("primary");
                    Qt.callLater(function () {
                        const pen = documentViewTools.activePen;
                        if (pen && (pen.tool === Line.Highlighterv2 || pen.tool === Line.Highlighter) && Line.Ballpointv2 !== undefined)
                            pen.tool = Line.Ballpointv2;
                    });
                } else {
                    root.qcGoBack();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Rectangle {
        id: qcBar
        visible: root.qcBarVisible
        z: 10000
        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
        anchors.bottomMargin: 180
        width: 900
        height: 124
        radius: 14
        color: "white"
        border.color: "black"
        border.width: 3
        Row {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            spacing: 20
            Rectangle {
                width: 220; height: 88; radius: 10; color: "black"
                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Save"; font.pixelSize: 34; color: "white" }
                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcSave(false) }
            }
            Rectangle {
                width: 330; height: 88; radius: 10; color: "black"
                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Save + note"; font.pixelSize: 34; color: "white" }
                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcSave(true) }
            }
            Rectangle {
                width: 240; height: 88; radius: 10; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Cancel"; font.pixelSize: 34; color: "black" }
                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcCancel() }
            }
        }
    }

    Row {
        id: qcLinks
        visible: root.qcIsNotebook() && !root.qcBackVisible && !root.qcIndexVisible
        z: 10000
        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.top: parent.top
        anchors.topMargin: 18
        anchors.leftMargin: 130
        spacing: 16
        Rectangle {
            width: qcIndexText.implicitWidth + 44; height: 72; radius: 10
            color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
            Text { id: qcIndexText; anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Index"; font.pixelSize: 30; color: "black" }
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcIndexVisible = true }
        }
        Rectangle {
            visible: !!root.qcCurrentCard
            width: qcOpenText.implicitWidth + 44; height: 72; radius: 10; color: "black"
            Text {
                id: qcOpenText
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                color: "white"
                font.pixelSize: 30
                text: root.qcCurrentCard ? "Open p. " + (root.qcCurrentCard.page + 1) + " \u2197" : ""
            }
            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: root.qcOpenSource(root.qcCurrentCard.sourceId, root.qcCurrentCard.page)
            }
        }
    }

    Rectangle {
        id: qcIndexPanel
        visible: root.qcIndexVisible && root.qcIsNotebook()
        z: 10001
        anchors.fill: parent
        anchors.margins: 60
        anchors.topMargin: 110
        color: "white"
        border.color: "black"
        border.width: 3
        radius: 14
        Text {
            id: qcIndexTitle
            anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.margins: 32
            text: "Commonplace  \u00B7  " + root.qcIndex.length + " notecards"
            font.pixelSize: 38; font.bold: true; color: "black"
        }
        Rectangle {
            anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.margins: 24
            width: 140; height: 72; radius: 10; color: "black"
            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Close"; font.pixelSize: 30; color: "white" }
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcIndexVisible = false }
        }
        ListView {
            anchors.top: qcIndexTitle.bottom; anchors.topMargin: 28
            anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
            anchors.leftMargin: 32; anchors.rightMargin: 32; anchors.bottomMargin: 24
            clip: true
            spacing: 10
            model: root.qcIndex.slice().reverse()
            delegate: Rectangle {
                width: ListView.view.width
                height: 112
                color: "white"
                border.color: "#999999"
                border.width: 1
                radius: 8
                Column {
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 20
                    anchors.right: qcRowButtons.left; anchors.rightMargin: 16
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    spacing: 6
                    Text {
                        width: parent.width; elide: Text.ElideRight
                        text: modelData.title + (modelData.author ? "  \u2014  " + modelData.author : "")
                        font.pixelSize: 30; color: "black"
                    }
                    Text {
                        width: parent.width; elide: Text.ElideRight
                        text: "p. " + (modelData.page + 1) + "  \u00B7  " + root.qcFormatTime(modelData.time)
                        font.pixelSize: 24; color: "#555555"
                    }
                }
                Row {
                    id: qcRowButtons
                    anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.rightMargin: 16
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    spacing: 12
                    Rectangle {
                        width: 170; height: 72; radius: 10; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                        Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Notecard"; font.pixelSize: 28; color: "black" }
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcGoToCard(modelData) }
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        width: 150; height: 72; radius: 10; color: "black"
                        Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Source \u2197"; font.pixelSize: 28; color: "white" }
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.qcOpenSource(modelData.sourceId, modelData.page) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Rectangle {
        id: qcBack
        visible: root.qcBackVisible && root.qcIsNotebook()
        z: 10000
        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.top: parent.top
        anchors.topMargin: 18
        anchors.leftMargin: 130
        width: qcBackText.implicitWidth + 48
        height: 72
        radius: 10
        color: "black"
        Text {
            id: qcBackText
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            color: "white"
            font.pixelSize: 32
            text: root.qcSource ? "← Back to p. " + (root.qcSource.page + 1) : "← Back"
        }
        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            onClicked: root.qcGoBack()
        }
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; ---------- highlight the captured passage in the book ----------
; While ❝ is on, the capture stroke is also handed to the tablet's own text highlighter
; (snap-to-text). A stroke dragged from the first word to the last highlights that passage.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
TRAVERSE ?#strokeHandler
REBUILD onStrokeCompleted
LOCATE AFTER STREAM | controller.createImageSnippetFromStroke(stroke,root.defaultScale); |
INSERT {
if (Values.qcArmed && !root.notePage) {
    try {
        controller.highlightWithLine(stroke, SceneController.SnapEnabled);
        console.log("QC highlight added");
    } catch (e) {
        console.log("QC highlight failed:", e);
    }
}
}
END REBUILD
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
